sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: GPS-Sealed Bonded Road Feeder Service for International Airports

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English Common Law, French Civil Law, and Customary Law)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: None (Vanuatu has no bilateral investment treaty or double taxation agreement currently in force)
PACER-Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 42 of 2016 (as amended); International Companies Act No. 32 of 1992 (Cap. 222), as amended; Companies Act No. 11 of 1986 (Cap. 191); Financial Transactions Reporting Act; subordinate UBO reporting regulations and VFSC directives requiring all International Companies to identify, verify, and file ultimate beneficial owner data with the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit and the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport (biometric page) for each director and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing authority or licensed notary in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization through the Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs (depending on the origin state's membership of the 1961 Apostille Convention)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement) for each director and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or the licensed commercial bank of the account-holder in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization through the Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter from a licensed commercial bank certifying the applicant's financial integrity and account history
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: The applicant's licensed commercial bank in its country of origin or residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization through the Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or corporate extract for any corporate shareholder or corporate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: The corporate registry or competent commercial registrar of the shareholder's country of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization through the Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of every director, shareholder, and ultimate beneficial owner against the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit's consolidated domestic sanctions list, OFAC SDN list, UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list, EU consolidated sanctions list, and INTERPOL notices. Screening must be completed before acceptance of any beneficial owner; enhanced due diligence is triggered automatically on any PEP match, including foreign civil servants, judiciary, armed forces, or state-owned enterprise executives.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) International Companies Registry – Online Name Reservation and Clearance Portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names may be submitted in English or French, or in any foreign language using a Latin-alphabet transliteration approved by the registered agent. If a non-Latin script is used, a certified transliteration into English or French must accompany the reservation application. The name must be distinguishable from existing names, must not imply a false connection with a government or public authority, and must be accepted by the VFSC in the exact form to be used in the certificate of incorporation.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The registered agent may file a written administrative appeal with the VFSC Registry Appeals Committee within 14 calendar days of a name rejection. The appeal must state grounds of distinction or lawful use, supported by a proposed memorandum of association and, where relevant, written ministerial consent for a sensitive token. The VFSC must respond in writing within 14 business days. If the administrative appeal is refused, the applicant may seek judicial review before the Supreme Court of Vanuatu. An extension of a previously reserved name may be applied for before expiry, generally granting an additional 30 days upon payment of the VFSC extension fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office is not permissible for the statutory registered office. Every International Company must maintain a physical registered office in Vanuatu at the premises of a VFSC-licensed registered agent. A virtual mailing address may be used only for supplementary operational correspondence and does not satisfy the statutory registered office requirement.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low quantified risk: for a low-risk non-financial customs bonded road feeder operator, the estimated likelihood of an unannounced physical on-site inspection in any calendar year is 1%–3%. Nonetheless, the VFSC and Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit retain unqualified statutory power to conduct on-site inspections and request commercial substance evidence under the AML/CFT regime.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap. 222] of the Republic of Vanuatu, sections 2-9 (incorporation), 28 (registered office), 77-83 (directors and officers); International Companies (Fees) Regulations 1997.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Registries Division - International Companies Registry, Kumul Highway, Port Vila.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Incorporation of an International Company (VFSC Form IC-1) together with the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; at least one share must be allotted and no escrow or capitalization requirement applies. A separate customs bond instrument (bank guarantee or cash deposit of USD 10,000-50,000) must be lodged with Customs for bonded truck operations.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Company's Memorandum and Articles of Association as filed with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission be and are hereby adopted; the subscribers' allotment of shares as stated in the declaration is approved and shares are issued accordingly. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office and resident agent be designated at the address of the Company's licensed registered agent and that directors and officers, including the company secretary, be appointed with the powers set out in the Articles. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the Managing Director be and is hereby authorized to open bank accounts, execute the Customs bonded carrier licence application, and file all transport, fire, environmental, and labour permits necessary to commence GPS-sealed bonded trucking operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Registry, Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit three preferred company names in a name-reservation application through a licensed registered agent; the Registry checks availability and conducts money-laundering screening of proposed directors and ultimate beneficial owners. A name approval is valid for 60 days.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Resubmit with alternative names; if a name conflicts with an existing registration, obtain a written consent letter from the prior holder or apply to the Registrar for a discretionary declaration of distinctiveness.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-licensed registered agent in Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the registered-agent engagement letter and registered-office services contract. The agent is statutorily required to hold a physical office in Vanuatu, maintain the statutory records, and submit the incorporation filing to the VFSC.
required_dossiers: KYC and source-of-funds forms for shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the agent fails internal compliance checks, appoint a substitute registered agent and notify the VFSC of the change of agent within 28 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent lodges Form IC-1 with the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association and consents of the first director and company secretary. The filing fee is payable by wire transfer to the VFSC or by agent disbursement.
required_dossiers: Signed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consent to act of the first director
Consent to act of the company secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: On a registrar's query, correct the defect and re-file within 14 days; unresolved refusals may be appealed to the Registrar and thereafter to the Supreme Court under section 112 of the Act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment of Fees and Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Pay the registration fee (approximately VT 40,000, equivalent to USD 350) and the Government processing levy. The Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation and the company comes into existence on the date stated in the certificate.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate is defective, apply for rectification and re-issue under the Registrar's administrative correction power; expedited re-issuance is available on request.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting and Share Issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors and company secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting or pass a written resolution to adopt the pro-forma resolution, record subscriber share allotment, issue share certificates, appoint officers, and open corporate bank accounts. Advance bank-account due-diligence forms are executed in parallel.
required_dossiers: Minutes or written resolution of the first board meeting
Share certificates and register of members
Board banking resolution and signatory mandates
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If share subscription or officer appointment is queried by the bank, pass a supplemental board resolution and provide enhanced KYC documentation for all signatories.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Lodgement of Customs Bond and GPS-Sealed Truck Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue (Customs Division), Port Vila and Bauerfield
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge a customs bond (bank guarantee or cash deposit within the USD 10,000-50,000 band set by the Director of Customs) and register each truck in the customs bonded carrier register. Each vehicle must have a GPS sealing system integrated with the Customs surveillance unit.
required_dossiers: Customs bond instrument or bank guarantee
Application for customs bonded carrier status
Vehicle registration certificates and GPS certification
Fleet schedule and driver customs-approval list
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Director of Customs deems security inadequate, lodge a supplemental bond or bank guarantee; a deficiency letter may be cured by filing revised fleet data and a corrective GPS audit report within 15 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Foreign Investment Certificate and Municipal Business Licence
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Foreign Investment Promotion Authority (FIPA) and Port Vila Municipal Council
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for a Foreign Investment Certificate (FIC) for the foreign-owned international company establishing physical transport operations, together with a municipal business licence under the Business Licence Act for the truck depot and offices.
required_dossiers: Certificate of incorporation and board resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where FIPA imposes conditions or defers approval, submit a compliance undertaking and revised local-content plan; a refusal may be appealed to the Minister responsible for trade within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Environmental Registration and Physical Works Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Public Works Department, Fire and Emergency Services, Department of Labour
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the environmental registration or statement for the depot (Category B), schedule fire-safety inspection and structural load verification of parking aprons and fuel storage, and submit the occupational health and safety plan for workplace clearance.
required_dossiers: EIA registration form and environmental management plan
Architectural and structural drawings of depot
Fire safety application and layout plan
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a deficiency notice issues, respond with a corrective environmental improvement plan or engineering certificate; unresolved disputes may be referred to the Environment Review Tribunal.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue (Customs Division) jointly with the Department of Transport, Ministry of Infrastructure and Public Utilities; airport access coordinated through Vanuatu Airports Limited at Bauerfield International Airport.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Customs Bonded Carrier Licence (Customs Act [Cap. 156]) and Road Goods Transport Operator Licence / Heavy Vehicle Permit (Transport Act [Cap. 34]); aerodrome-side access authorized by a Ground Vehicle Permit from the Vanuatu Civil Aviation Administration.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards, Environment and Climate Change
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B (Registration): a small bonded truck-fleet depot with paved yard, wash bay and fuel storage below 10,000 L requires an Environmental Statement and registration; a full EIA Report is triggered only where hazardous-cargo throughput, coastal siting, or wetland disturbance is involved.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero untreated wastewater discharge; wash-bay effluent must pass through a grease trap and oil-water separator; petroleum storage requires 110% secondary-containment bunding; vehicles must pass annual emissions and roadworthiness inspection with no visible exhaust smoke; no open burning of waste; spill-response equipment must be available on site at all times.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from Vanuatu Fire and Emergency Services covering depot, fuel area, and offices; structural load inspection certificate from the Public Works Department for parking aprons and racking; workplace inspection clearance and occupational health and safety compliance from the Department of Labour; Customs security clearance for all bonded-fleet drivers and warehouse personnel.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (DCIR) – https://www.customs.gov.vu; Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – https://www.vfsc.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned International Company (IC) is incorporated with VFSC under the International Companies Act Cap 222, obtaining a Certificate of Incorporation and a Tax Exemption Certificate confirming zero income tax. No domestic tax TIN is required because the IC is tax-exempt. For customs operations, the entity must apply separately to DCIR for a Customs Business Code (CBC) and a bonded transporter/warehouse licence under the Customs Act Cap 42; this application requires the certificate of incorporation, board resolution, identity documents of officers, and proof of a registered local agent/physical address in Vanuatu.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None applicable. Vanuatu levies no national income tax, and ICs are automatically exempt without any check-the-box election. No hybrid mismatch or flow-through election exists under Vanuatu law. The only optional elections relate to customs duty treatment (e.g., temporary importation, bonded transit) for which a bond or security must be lodged with DCIR.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT/GST regime in force; indirect taxation is limited to customs import duties and stamp duty under the Customs Act Cap 42 and the Stamp Duties Act Cap 117.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: N/A – Vanuatu has no VAT/GST and therefore no turnover threshold. A Customs Business Code (CBC) is mandatory for any bonded or transit cargo operation irrespective of revenue or transaction volume.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None. Vanuatu has no national e-invoicing or fiscal clearance platform. Customs declarations are lodged electronically through the ASYCUDA World system or on approved paper forms; there is no digital stamping or real-time tax clearance API requirement.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: N/A because Vanuatu does not levy VAT/GST. No zero-rating claim exists. For customs duty purposes, goods transported by bonded truck feeder services that are exported directly from Vanuatu are free of export duties provided the export declaration is lodged and the goods are shown to have left Vanuatu permanently.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (SAD) lodged in ASYCUDA World
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill (or CMR for road feeder movement)
Bonded Transport Authorization / Transshipment Permit issued by DCIR
Continuous Customs Bond or Bank Security covering the bonded truck fleet
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Vanuatu has no exchange control and imposes no statutory FX repatriation deadline. However, DCIR may audit bonded trucking operators intensively; false export declarations, misdescription of destinations, or diversion of bonded cargo into the local market attract penalties of up to 10–20 times the duty evaded, imprisonment up to 5 years, forfeiture of the bonded fleet, and suspension or cancellation of the customs transporter licence. VFSC may also revoke the IC's tax exemption certificate for serious customs offences, resulting in retrospective loss of exemption status and disqualification of directors.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), established under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act 1980, with full responsibility for monetary policy, the issue of the Vanuatu vatu, exchange rate administration, and banking supervision under the Banking Act 2018 and the Financial Institutions Act.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu operates as an IMF Article VIII jurisdiction with no formal exchange controls on current payments or capital transfers. The Vanuatu vatu (VUV) is fully convertible for trade-related receipts, dividends, loan repayments and capital returns. Profit remittance hurdles are not statutory, but each bank applies AML/CFT-source-of-funds due diligence before releasing outward payments. For a Vanuatu International Company, income and capital distributions are tax-exempt, and no Vanuatu withholding tax is imposed on outbound dividends, interest, royalties or service fees; the practical constraint is documentary verification and sanctions screening by the correspondent banking chain.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory export proceeds surrender obligation and no mandatory conversion ratio apply in Vanuatu. Exporters and customs bonded operators may retain foreign currency earnings in external accounts or sell them into VUV at the free interbank market rate. The receiving bank must still record inward remittances for RBV statistical purposes and, for customs bonded aviation trucking, the operator should retain transport documents, customs receipts and airport cargo manifests to evidence the trade payment.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational VUV and foreign currency accounts

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low viability as a primary treasury rail. Vanuatu does not maintain a separate electronic money institution licensing category, and any deposit-taking institution must hold a banking license from RBV under the Banking Act 2018. An offshore digital EMI cannot open a resident operating account unless it becomes a licensed Vanuatu branch or negotiates a correspondent banking relationship with an ANZ/BSP-type institution. Such an arrangement adds intermediary risk, restricted account segmentation, and is structurally unsuitable for capital escrow or customs bonded payment flows.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: A fully remote account opening is generally not accepted for a newly incorporated International Company. RBV prudential practice and Tier 1 bank policies require at least one physical director or authorised signatory to attend the onboarding interview, or a video-verified interview supported by notarised board resolutions, certified passport copies, and VFSC-issued corporate records. In practice, the first account opening requires a notary/embassy verification step; subsequent signatories may be added remotely.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity in a Vanuatu International Company, especially nominee shareholders or bearer share capabilities
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC-issued certificate of incorporation; current director and register of directors; register of shareholders and beneficial owners; signed bank-compliant beneficial ownership declaration; legal opinion from a licensed Vanuatu law firm; corporate group structure chart showing the ultimate human beneficial owners.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear source of wealth and source of funds for the initial fleet purchase and capital injection
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Six months of bank statements from the transferring entity; audited or accountant-certified financial statements; the airport concession or customs bonded trucking service contract; vendor pro-forma invoice for fleet vehicles; third-party equipment valuation certificate; personal net worth statement if funds are from individuals.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border sanctions and PEP exposure due to non-resident ultimate owners or intermediate holding jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Completed sanctions and PEP questionnaire; certified passports of all directors and beneficial owners; utility bills and bank reference letters; negative media search report; sworn affidavit affirming no sanctions-linkage and no prohibited aviation/customs goods involvement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Regulatory licence validity for the customs bonded trucking and airport feeder service
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid customs bonded operator licence or customs transport permit; VFSC International Company certificate with business purpose mirroring ISIC 5222; airport access and security clearance agreements; fleet insurance certificate; customs bond guarantee documentation; driver and cargo handling AML/CTF procedure manual.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound capital injections should be routed as SWIFT MT103 wires through a Tier 1 Vanuatu licensed bank, quoting clear remittance purpose codes for share capital, intercompany loan or capital contribution. The receiving bank must receive a board resolution approving the injection, the share allotment or loan agreement, and proof of beneficial owner verification before funds are credited. Funds should initially enter a VUV capital escrow account, then be converted at the commercial interbank rate into the operational VUV/USD/AUD account. For customs bonded trucking, inward remittances above USD 100,000 should be supported by the fleet purchase contract and customs entry documents to avoid retained-funds holds.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: The primary outbound clearing rails are SWIFT MT103 for high-value international supplier payments and domestic RTGS-style credit transfers for VUV local costs. International equipment purchases above USD 50,000 should be settled through an irrevocable Commercial Letter of Credit governed by UCP600, especially for GPS-sealed bonded trucks and aviation security equipment. All trade disbursements must be matched to the underlying customs bonded service invoice, airport delivery acknowledgement and insurance/Fuel documentation; the bank will apply standard correspondent fees and a 100-150 basis point margin on cross-currency conversions.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Spot VUV/USD and VUV/AUD contracts at the commercial interbank rate
Deliverable VUV forward pairings offered by Tier 1 licensed Vanuatu banks, where available
Non-deliverable forward (NDF) for VUV/USD via an offshore prime broker if local deliverability constraints apply
Cross-currency interest rate swap for long-term matched truck fleet financing against future airport concession revenues

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: International Company Annual Renewal Fee (License Fee)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Registry of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before each anniversary of incorporation; processed by the licensed registered agent.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment triggers penalty interest and late fees; continued non-payment after the anniversary month leads to administrative strike-off of the International Company and loss of legal personality.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent Compliance Confirmation (AML/CFT Annual Update)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Registered Agent on record with VFSC
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the company anniversary date, or within 30 days of any change in beneficial ownership or registered particulars.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to update beneficial ownership details is an offence under the Vanuatu AML/CFT and Beneficial Ownership framework; administrative fines may be imposed on the registered agent and, in egregious cases, the company may be struck off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory statutory audit for a Vanuatu International Company, irrespective of annual turnover or asset size. An audit becomes necessary only if the entity separately obtains a regulated financial services license or voluntarily elects to produce independently audited statements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Not prescribed under the International Companies Act. Voluntary financial statements may be prepared under IFRS, Vanuatu National Accounting Standards, or other acceptable GAAP; no financial statements need be filed with the VFSC.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vanuatu International Companies are not required to file a public beneficial ownership return with the VFSC. Each IC must maintain a beneficial ownership register at its registered office, and the licensed registered agent must annually confirm and update underlying ownership and control information as part of the territory’s AML/CFT obligations.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not required; voluntary certified audit USD 1,500 – 3,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax on International Companies (IC) under the International Companies Act, which constitutes a full statutory exemption.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: IC status grants complete exemption from any present or future Vanuatu corporate income tax, capital gains tax, stamp duty on instruments, and dividend, interest, or royalty withholding tax. The effective tax burden is zero on profits, distributions, and capital gains, conditioned on maintaining non-resident business conduct, a registered agent, and an annual VFSC filing. No incentives of the reduced-rate type exist because the tax rate is already nil.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: International Company Annual Return (Form ICS-AR) filed exclusively through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) online registry portal, vfsc.vu. No corporate income tax return form is issued or filed because the IC regime imposes zero CIT; the annual return is the sole statutory disclosure instrument.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within three (3) months after each anniversary of incorporation. A written extension of up to a further three (3) months may be granted by VFSC if requested before the due date. No tax return deadline exists at the national level, but the VFSC annual return is universally required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company name, including prior names, registered number, and registration date.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact name shown on the Certificate of Incorporation; no modification by trade name or foreign translation is permitted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address in Vanuatu and name of the licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign directors must obtain and rely on the registered agent's physical address in Port Vila; cannot designate a P.O. box or virtual office abroad.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Directors, secretary, and their residential addresses, nationality, and passport numbers.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors must provide full identity information and, if not physically in Vanuatu, must nonetheless confirm service process arrangements through the agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Shareholder/member ledger, including class of shares, number of shares, consideration paid and transfer restrictions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For wholly foreign-owned coverage, disclose all beneficial owners, even if nominee holders are used, to comply with the VFSC beneficial ownership register.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of non-resident status: confirmation that the company has not carried on business with Vanuatu residents and does not control/own land in Vanuatu, subject to permitted leases.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If an airport feeder truck arrangement requires physical presence, ensure the activity is limited to international bonded transit outside the ordinary domestic freight market; a breach requires immediate agent notification and cannot be corrected by backdating.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Economic substance and licence declaration, including VFSC licence category and any customs/transport permits for the bonded truck fleet.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a customs bonded fleet operator, attach the GPS-sealed transport permit, customs-bonded trailer registration, and VFSC acknowledgement of licences; this confirms legal physicality and defeats loss of zero-tax status.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file the VFSC annual return within the statutory date triggers a late filing penalty of VUV 5,000 per month or part month, up to VUV 25,000. Continued non-compliance results in the company being struck off the register, reinstatement fees exceeding VUV 10,000, and a period of legal incapacity. Directors are jointly and severally liable for the late filings; however, no corporate income tax surcharge can arise because there is no underlying CIT to compute.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu does not impose any dividend withholding tax on distributions made by an International Company to its foreign shareholders.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double tax treaty network. Accordingly, no treaty-reduced withholding rate can be invoked in Vanuatu, and the IC cannot use the local courts to claim DTA relief because no relevant Double Tax Agreement is in force with the source country of the IC's income. Where a foreign jurisdiction requires a tax residence certificate or benefit-ownership declaration, the applicant must request a letter from VFSC confirming the IC's incorporation and good standing, then file that certificate under the foreign jurisdiction's domestic procedure or under a foreign treaty between the foreign jurisdiction and Vanuatu, if any.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory and treaty-equivalent rate on royalties and interest paid by an IC to non-residents. Because Vanuatu retains no taxing rights, there is no statutory withholding and no treaty limitation. However, payments flowing through source jurisdictions are subject to that jurisdiction's rates; in a typical Vanuatu operational structure, the IC only receives payments and remits them without a Vanuatu-level charge.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable in Vanuatu — the IC law does not prescribe Local File or Master File thresholds. For the customs bonded truck fleet, no VAT or CIT return therefore no transfer-pricing filing. Nevertheless, a VFSC substance declaration may require controlled transaction data when the annual foreign-related turnover exceeds VUV 30,000,000 (administrative guidance; not a tax obligation).
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Vanuatu statutory regime (International Companies Act and subsidiary regulations and the Beneficial Ownership Act 2019) applies economic substance as a precondition of the IC exemption. The IC must, at all times, maintain a registered office, a licensed agent and records. For an ISIC 5222 bonded truck fleet, the VFSC and the Customs Commissioner expect: a physical fleet management office in Vanuatu; at least one director or senior manager actually managing the feeder operation; GPS-linked fleet data and customs-bonded evidence; and local employees/expenditure sufficient to demonstrate that the profitable freight activity is not mere offshore booking. Failure to satisfy this doctrine when a licence is required leads to cancellation and retroactive taxation through a different entity form.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Illicit use of zero-tax IC to evade customs duty on bonded vehicles and freight.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the GPS-sealed truck fleet with duty-exempt imported chassis while carrying domestic cargo, or removing goods from a bonded warehouse without paying import VAT and customs duty, thereby turning the IC exemption into a tariff-avoidance vehicle.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Vanuatu Customs Act, the Customs Commissioner recovers 200% of the assessed duty as a penalty, seizes the truck, bond, and fuel, cancels the Customs Bonded Carrier Licence and imposes an additional VUV one million administrative fine per violation. The Vanuatu tax and customs authorities are also entitled to treat the IC as a local carrier for the whole fiscal year, removing its zero-tax status.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Where directors instruct routing of duty-exempt bonded cargo into domestic circulation or allow GPS seal tampering, the corporate veil is pierced: directors are jointly liable for the unpaid duties and penalties, may be prohibited from leaving Vanuatu by court order pending payment, and face imprisonment not exceeding five years for deliberate customs fraud.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Registering the customs bonded truck fleet IC solely to administer international freight invoices without owning or physically directing the GPS-sealed vehicles, with no registered active management, no payroll in Vanuatu, and using the IC name merely as a conduit for bank transfers.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The VFSC can strike the IC off the registry, declare its corporate existence void with retroactive effect, and impose a fine of VUV 2,000,000 against the company or its authorised officer for obtaining VFSC registration through materially false asset/substance representations. If the IC carries on business in Vanuatu through a domestic depot without a transport licence, the Ministry of Infrastructure will revoke operating permits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who signed a substance declaration that overstated fleet ownership or employment are subject to disqualification as directors for a period of five years, personally liable for all wages owed, charges, and fines of up to VUV 500,000 incurred during the period of illegality, and can be sentenced to up to two years' imprisonment under the International Companies Act offence provisions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML/CFT failure for beneficial ownership and licensed financial transport operations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Concealing the ultimate beneficial owner from the VFSC Beneficial Ownership Register when the truck fleet is owned by a corporate nominee or family trust, or receiving large wire transfers (ACH/wire) without carrying out enhanced customer due diligence, and not reporting suspicious freight invoices linked to tax-haven shell suppliers.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Vanuatu's AML/CFT Act (as amended), the financial/corporate compliance supervisor issues a penalty of up to VUV 10,000,000 for a first offence and suspends the VFSC licence for a bonded transport operator when suspicious transaction reporting is omitted.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors with actual or constructive knowledge of the concealed beneficial ownership face personal fines up to VUV 2,000,000, a freeze of their own bank accounts, and imprisonment for seven years for money laundering facilitation; in addition, they may remain personally liable for the entire funds flowing through the bonded trucking contracts as restitution to the government.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: False annual return / false certification to VFSC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Filing an annual return which knowingly understates foreign operations, denies having any Vanuatu domestic transport activity, or certifies a registered agent address that is not actually staffed or that directs the customs bonded customs bond from a non-existing legal entity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Providing false documents or information under the International Companies Act is a criminal offence: fine of up to VUV 5,000,000, disqualification from participation in any Vanuatu licensed entity for ten years, and immediate revocation of all customs transport permits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Every director who approved the false return is vicariously liable for VUV 1,000,000 in restitution to the VFSC; in egregious cases, a court may impose a travel ban and order the director's detention for contempt until the false filing is corrected. This cannot be the subject of company-wide indemnity. The judicial consequence may be imprisonment not exceeding fifteen years under general fraud provisions if the false return is a predicate for obtaining money or goods by deception.
